preamble: Lateralization of the alveolar implosive: [ɗ] becomes [l]. In Shan and Tai Nüa, Proto-Tai *ɗ (Li's *ʔd) usually gives l, while Thai and Lao keep d (Proto-Tai *ɗɤjᴬ 'good' > Thai ดี, Shan လီ /liː/). The change runs parallel to *ɓ > m in the same languages: the implosive becomes a sonorant at the same place of articulation, a nasal for the labial and a lateral for the coronal.
